svg.title: determinant of matrix 5 by 5: row 1: 1, x sub 1, x sub 1 squared, and so on, x sub 1 to the power, n minus 1, end exponent; row 2: 1, x sub 2, x sub 2 squared, and so on, x sub 2 to the power, n minus 1, end exponent; row 3: 1, x sub 3, x sub 3 squared, and so on, x sub 3 to the power, n minus 1, end exponent; row 4: ⋮, ⋮, ⋮, ⋱, ⋮; row 5: 1, x sub n, x sub n squared, and so on, x sub n to the power, n minus 1, end exponent equals product over 1 is less than or equal to i is less than j is less than or equal to n of open paren x sub j minus x sub i close paren

metadata.mathra:source: \det \begin{pmatrix} 1 & x_1 & x_1^2 & \cdots & x_1^{n-1} \\ 1 & x_2 & x_2^2 & \cdots & x_2^{n-1} \\ 1 & x_3 & x_3^2 & \cdots & x_3^{n-1} \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ 1 & x_n & x_n^2 & \cdots & x_n^{n-1} \end{pmatrix} = \prod_{1 \le i < j \le n} \left( x_j - x_i \right)
